question: The glycosidic bond in the disaccharides is characterized by:

options.opa: Involve at least one anomeric carbon.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Disaccharides contain glycosidic bonds" -> "Glycosidic bonds involve anomeric carbons" -> "At least one anomeric carbon is present" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Maltose is a disaccharide" -> "Maltose consists of two glucose units" -> "One glucose unit has an anomeric carbon" -> "The bond can be in beta configuration" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Glycosidic bonds can be N-glycosidic" -> "N-glycosidic bonds involve nitrogen" -> "Disaccharides typically do not have N-glycosidic bonds" -> "This option is less likely" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Glycosidic bonds are not cargo" -> "Cargo refers to transport molecules" -> "This option does not apply to glycosidic bonds" -> 85%
analysis: The glycosidic bond in disaccharides involves the linkage between two monosaccharides, which includes at least one anomeric carbon. Maltose specifically has an alpha configuration, not beta. N-glycosidic bonds are typically found in nucleotides, not disaccharides. The term 'present cargo' is unclear in this context.
